heading: I own systems from first commit to production.
paragraphs: I'm a **Lead IT and full-stack engineer**, most recently at YouCode Technologies, where I owned multiple production systems end to end: architecture, development, automated testing, CI/CD, and on-premise infrastructure. I was **promoted to lead within my first year.**

My favorite work spans the whole stack. I was the sole developer of *Usapp*, a secure real-time messaging platform built from scratch across mobile, distributed microservices, deployment pipeline and production servers, now the notification backbone for the company's entire product suite.

I care about the unglamorous parts too: **security scanning in CI, hardened containers, monitoring, and incident diagnosis at 3 a.m.** This site is part of the evidence: **every section, color and sentence is editable config, no code changes.**
philosophy: "Build it, secure it, ship it, run it, end to end."
